question: How much is fifty pounds in kilos, roughly? My bag scale at home only shows pounds.
expected_answer: Fifty pounds is roughly 22.7 kilos, since one pound is about 0.45 kg.

key_facts: 50 pounds is about 22.7 kg
1 pound is about 0.45 kg

question: Why does it cost so much more to pay for extra bag weight at the airport?
expected_answer: Excess baggage that isn't prepaid is charged at the airport at ₹600 per kg, whereas buying it online up to 4 hours before departure is cheaper, for example 5 kg for ₹2,250.

key_facts: Excess baggage not bought in advance is charged at the airport at ₹600 per kg
Prepaid excess baggage bought on the website or app up to 4 hours before departure costs: 5 kg ₹2,250

question: How many kilos exactly can my cabin bag be? Like, the one for the overhead bin.
expected_answer: Your cabin bag can weigh no more than 5 kg and must fit within 55 cm x 35 cm x 25 cm; you can also bring one personal item of up to 2 kg.

key_facts: one cabin bag weighing no more than 5 kg
55 cm x 35 cm x 25 cm
one personal item weighing up to 2 kg
meta.common_prior: 7 kg, the standard cabin bag allowance on Indian domestic airlines.

question: The ticket says it's direct, so what's the difference between that and non-stop?
expected_answer: A non-stop flight goes straight to the destination with no landings in between, while a direct flight keeps the same flight number but may land at an intermediate airport on the way, usually without you changing planes.
answer_aliases: direct can have a stop with the same flight number

history.text: Hi, I'm booked to Kochi on the twentieth, the evening one.
Okay, I can see that booking, the evening departure on the twentieth.

key_facts: non-stop means no intermediate landings
direct keeps one flight number but may stop on the way

question: What's the difference between Saver and Flexi when it comes to checked bags?
expected_answer: Saver includes 15 kg of checked baggage in a single piece, while Flexi includes 20 kg in a single piece.

key_facts: Saver: 15 kg of checked baggage in a single piece
Flexi: 20 kg of checked baggage in a single piece

question: What does 'final call' mean when it flashes up before my flight?
expected_answer: Final call is the last boarding announcement before the gate closes, so anyone not yet on board should go to the gate immediately or risk missing the flight.
answer_aliases: last boarding announcement before the gate closes

key_facts: final call is the last boarding call before the gate closes
go to the gate immediately

question: Uh, how late can I drop my bag at the counter for the Delhi flight?
expected_answer: Check-in and bag drop counters close 75 minutes before the scheduled departure time on every domestic flight, so you should reach the airport at least 2 hours before.
answer_aliases: an hour and a quarter before

key_facts: check-in counters close 75 minutes before the scheduled departure time
This closing time also applies to the bag drop counters
meta.common_prior: 45 to 60 minutes before departure, as at most Indian domestic airlines.

question: How many minutes before my flight does the boarding gate actually close?
expected_answer: Boarding gates close 25 minutes before departure; they open 60 minutes before departure.

key_facts: Boarding gates open 60 minutes before departure and close 25 minutes before departure

question: How long is a PNR supposed to be? I just can't find mine in the email.
expected_answer: A PNR, or booking reference, is a six-character code made of letters and numbers, normally shown near the top of the booking confirmation.

key_facts: a PNR is a six-character alphanumeric code
it is the same as the booking reference

question: How early can I do the online check-in for my Saturday morning flight?
expected_answer: Web check-in opens 72 hours before departure and closes 60 minutes before departure.

key_facts: Web check-in opens 72 hours before departure and closes 60 minutes before departure

question: Can my eight-year-old sit with me in the exit row? I'd be right beside him.
expected_answer: No, children can't sit in an emergency exit row, because everyone seated there must be able to open the exit and help other passengers in an evacuation.

key_facts: children cannot sit in emergency exit rows
exit-row passengers must be able to assist in an evacuation

question: Why was there a fee to pick my seat when my friend got hers free?
expected_answer: On a Saver fare, choosing a seat in advance is paid (₹350 for a standard aisle or window seat, ₹150 for a middle seat) and the free seat is only assigned at random at check-in, whereas Flexi passengers can choose any standard seat free of charge.

key_facts: Saver passengers who do not buy a seat receive a free seat assigned at random at check-in
standard aisle or window seats ₹350
Flexi passengers can choose any standard seat free of charge

question: If I change my date, is the 'fare difference' on top of the change fee?
expected_answer: The fare difference is the gap between what you originally paid and the current price of the new flight; if the new fare costs more you pay that gap, and it is separate from and in addition to any change fee.
answer_aliases: the price gap between the old and new fare
yes, on top of the change fee

key_facts: fare difference is the new fare's current price minus what you paid
it is charged separately from any change fee

question: What does it cost to cancel my Saver ticket a week before?
expected_answer: Cancelling a Saver ticket more than 72 hours before departure costs ₹3,500 per passenger per flight, and the rest is refunded.

key_facts: Cancellation fee ₹3,500 per passenger per flight if cancelled more than 72 hours before departure

question: Is it possible to change my Flexi ticket for free the day before the flight?
expected_answer: Yes, the first change on a Flexi booking is free as long as it is made at least 4 hours before departure, but any fare difference is still payable.
answer_aliases: free if at least 4 hours before

key_facts: the first change is free if made at least 4 hours before departure
any fare difference is payable on a change

question: Why does a refund from you take longer to reach my card than the payment did?
expected_answer: A payment is approved instantly, but a refund has to be sent back by the merchant's bank through the card network and then posted by your own bank, and each step runs in processing batches.

key_facts: refunds pass from the merchant's bank through the card network to your bank
each step is processed in batches, unlike an instant payment approval

question: How long does a refund usually take to get back to my card after I cancel?
expected_answer: Refunds to the original payment method are processed within 21 working days of the cancellation; if you'd rather, a credit shell is available immediately.

key_facts: refunds to credit cards, debit cards, UPI and net banking are processed within 21 working days of the cancellation
a credit shell, which is available immediately

question: Why does the name on my ticket have to match my ID exactly?
expected_answer: Airport security and the airline check your photo ID against the boarding pass to confirm you are the person booked, and tickets are not transferable, so a mismatch can stop you from boarding.

key_facts: the ID is checked against the ticket to confirm identity
tickets are not transferable to another person

question: Can I get a spelling mistake in my surname fixed on the booking?
expected_answer: No, no change or correction to a passenger's name is allowed once a booking is confirmed, including spelling mistakes; you would need to cancel and rebook, which is free only within the 48-hour look-in window.

key_facts: does not allow any change or correction to a passenger's name once a booking is confirmed
This includes spelling mistakes
the booking must be cancelled and a new booking made in the correct name
meta.common_prior: Yes, minor spelling corrections are usually allowed free or for a small fee.

question: Can I cancel just his ticket and keep mine as it is?
expected_answer: Yes, but partial cancellations can only be done through the contact centre (6 am to 11 pm), not in Manage Booking, and there's a split fee of ₹500 per booking on top of the cancellation fee for his ticket.

history.text: There's two of us on one booking, me and my brother.
Okay, I can see both passengers on that booking.

key_facts: Partial cancellations can only be done through the contact centre, not in Manage Booking
a split fee of ₹500 per booking in addition to the cancellation fee
open from 6 am to 11 pm
meta.plausible_wrong_answer: Yes, just cancel his ticket in Manage Booking online and you'll only pay the cancellation fee for him.

question: Is it possible to stop my baby's ears hurting when the plane's coming down?
expected_answer: Usually, yes: give the baby a feed, bottle or dummy during descent, because sucking and swallowing help open the ear tubes and equalise the pressure change.

key_facts: sucking or swallowing during descent helps equalise ear pressure
feed or give a dummy on the way down

question: Your website says my six-year-old can't fly alone with the minor service, why's that?
expected_answer: The unaccompanied minor service is only available for children aged 8 to 14, so a child under 8 can't travel without an accompanying passenger aged 18 or above, even with the service.

key_facts: the unaccompanied minor service is only available for children aged 8 to 14
Children under 8 cannot travel without an accompanying passenger aged 18 or above
meta.common_prior: Children from 5 years old can usually fly alone using the unaccompanied minor service.

question: How much do you charge to add her to the booking?
expected_answer: The infant fee is ₹1,750 per infant per flight, so a return trip would be ₹1,750 each way.

history.text: We're flying to Jaipur next month with our daughter.
Lovely. How old will she be when you travel?
Okay, then she'd travel on your lap.

key_facts: The infant fee is ₹1,750 per infant per flight

question: If a flight gets diverted, where do we actually end up, like what happens?
expected_answer: A diverted flight lands at an airport other than the scheduled destination, for example because of weather, a medical emergency or a technical issue, and once it is safe the airline continues the journey or arranges onward travel.

key_facts: a diversion means landing at an airport other than the planned destination
the journey continues once it is safe or onward travel is arranged

question: What happens if I miss my flight, can I get on the next one that day?
expected_answer: Under Go-Show, if you report to the transfer desk within 2 hours of the scheduled departure you can move to the next flight to the same destination that day for a flat ₹2,000 per passenger, subject to seats; otherwise you're a no-show and the base fare is forfeited.

key_facts: report to the Saffron Kite Air transfer desk at the airport within 2 hours of the scheduled departure time
a flat ₹2,000 per passenger, subject to seats being available
meta.plausible_wrong_answer: If you miss your flight you're a no-show, so you'd have to buy a new ticket (or ask to go standby on the next flight).

question: If my flight's delayed by a few hours, do you give us food or anything?
expected_answer: If the delay is more than 2 hours you get a meal voucher worth ₹300 per passenger, and if it goes past 6 hours you can choose a free change within 7 days or a full refund.

key_facts: delayed by more than 2 hours
a meal voucher worth ₹300 per passenger
If the delay is more than 6 hours, you may choose a free change within 7 days or a full refund
meta.plausible_wrong_answer: Yes, airlines provide refreshments during long delays.

question: I'm on a Saver ticket, can I pack my power bank in my checked bag?
expected_answer: No, power banks and spare lithium batteries must go in your cabin bag and are not allowed in checked baggage, because a battery fire in the hold can't be spotted or put out, while crew can deal with one in the cabin.

key_facts: power banks must be carried in cabin baggage, not checked baggage
lithium batteries are a fire risk that crew can only tackle in the cabin

question: So do I have to book ahead to bring my cat in the cabin with me?
expected_answer: Yes, pets must be booked through the contact centre at least 48 hours before departure; they're allowed on flights under 2 hours, pet and carrier together up to 7 kg, at ₹3,500 per pet per flight.

key_facts: pets must be booked through the contact centre at least 48 hours before departure
flights with a scheduled duration of under 2 hours
₹3,500 per pet per flight

question: What's the point of it though, does it get us there any faster?
expected_answer: No, priority boarding doesn't change the departure or arrival time; it just lets you board earlier, so you can settle in and find overhead bin space before the cabin fills up.

history.text: My seat on the Goa flight came with priority boarding.
Yes, I can see that on your booking for the front-row seat.

key_facts: priority boarding does not make the flight leave or arrive earlier
it lets you board first and get overhead bin space

question: What does Gold in the Monsoon Club actually mean for my baggage?
expected_answer: Gold members get 10 kg of extra checked baggage on every flight, along with priority check-in and boarding, a free standard seat and 4 free lounge visits per calendar year.

key_facts: Gold members get 10 kg of extra checked baggage
4 free lounge visits per calendar year
